snippet.title: Critters Vs. Preditor's Trailer v2
snippet.description:
The food chain is fighting back.

Critters vs. Predators is a cozy-chaotic auto-battler RPG. Recruit a warband of tiny critters, gear them up, pick who stands where, then watch them take on the foxes, cats, snakes, hawks, raccoons, crows, owls and bears that hunt them.

🐰 33 critters to collect, in seven classes, each with their own attacks, specials and a leader ability
🗺️ Ten chapters from the backyard to the badger's sett, on Normal and Hard, with a boss at the end of every one
⚔️ Auto or manual battles: attack, defend, taunt, abilities, and click to focus a target
🐾 Guild raids: ten raids, three days each, every attack free, the prize pool shared by damage dealt. Beat a predator family's raid and its young one joins your side
🏟️ A weekly twenty-floor Colosseum, a PvP arena with a server leaderboard, and a new event every few days
⭐ Stars, levels and six-slot gear through twenty tiers, all earned by playing

No loot boxes. No paid currency. Nothing that makes you stronger is for sale. Ever.

Coming to Steam Early Access.

🌐 Website and manual: https://lerkinteractive.com/cvp
💬 Community forum: https://lerkinteractive.com/cvp/forum/
🎮 Steam page: coming soon (wishlist link will be added here)

Made by Lerk Interactive on the Offender Engine.
